subject: E-Commerce
title: Currency Conversion Fees
description: A quick, practical guide to Currency Conversion Fees.

hook.text: Hidden currency conversion fees add 3-5% to cross-border purchases. Customers rarely see the markup.

buildup.text: When you buy in a foreign currency, your bank converts at its rate—plus a fee. Merchants add their own markup.

discovery.text: Double conversion happens when the seller charges USD, your bank converts to EUR, and adds a cross-border fee.

twist.text: Wise (formerly TransferWise) exposed these hidden fees and offered mid-market rates. Banks fought back.

climax.text: Currency conversion is a hidden tax on global shoppers. Transparency is improving, but slowly.

punchline.text: 3-5% hidden on every cross-border buy. Currency conversion is a quiet tax.

quiz.question: What is 'double conversion' in cross-border payments?
options: Multiple markup layers from seller and bank currency conversions stacking
